rule_as_implemented: wide, no-ball (Overstep) and 'other' extras are illegal; bye, leg-bye, penalty and ordinary balls are legal
evidence: 'other' counted legal would put 150 innings past 120 legal balls (data_exploration.ipynb); with it illegal the max is 120

rule_as_implemented: innings 3 and 4 are super overs and are kept in every rating. Each super-over ball is a death ball; occasion is max(stage occasion, 1.5), so a dead rubber or league super over counts as a knockout and a semi-final or final keeps 2 or 3; the second super over chases the first super over's total + 1
innings_ball_num is the ball sequence; rows sorted by match, innings, innings_ball_num
split seasons (2022/23 etc.) take the earlier year
IPL by name prefix, T20I by match_format, everything else Other T20
evidence: Other T20 = Emerging Teams Asia Cup 2024 and Asia Cup Rising Stars 2025

rule_as_implemented: IPL, T20I, and T20 (Other T20). Elo and expectation cells never share across ladders
a T20 (Emerging/Rising) ball counts as 0.5 of a ball in every count and mean
0.9^(2026-season) weights band rates and n_eff (not baseline rates, peers, clutch or consistency)
Caught, Bowled, LBW, Stump, Hit Wicket credit the bowler; run outs, retired out, obstructing do not
wide: all runs; no-ball/other: extras1 + bat runs; byes, leg-byes, penalty free
revised overs columns are ball counts; blank second innings copies the first; a blank both stays 120
revised_target used as supplied; otherwise first-innings total + 1; reduced match without a target gets no required rate; the second super over (innings 4) chases the first super over's total + 1
powerplay is ball <= round(0.3*length), death is ball > round(0.8*length) using legal-ball position; every super-over ball is death
modal batting order: 1-3 top, 4-6 middle, 7+ lower
40 duplicate (match, team, player) rows collapsed; conflicting batting orders blanked
rows whose amount does not fit the type are kept as supplied
